purpose: Full lettering-free panel reconstruction, with original artwork restored after generated extension work.
inputs: prepare_inputs.py extracts page 247 from the local PDF through the established ink/background pipeline. The raw originals, smoothed locks, fixed canvases, reference crops and selected generated results are retained here.
assembly: tools/extensions/graft/build.py builds panels 1 to 3 by grafting one whole-scene drawing per panel round the locked scan (see tools/extensions/graft/README.md); panel 4 is the locked scan with its existing left extension.
generation: Whole-scene drawings by Codex's image generation; the chosen ones are in tools/extensions/graft/picks. The earlier prompts and generated images kept in this directory are no longer used.
preservation: All four panels preserve the full cleaned scan rectangle pixel for pixel.
review: build_review.py creates panels.html with full-resolution links and a source overlay, and output/full-panels.zip. The editor crop/layout assets are separate from these full-art exports.
visualReview: 1: Dad walks toward the seated child; his trailing heel is completed.
2: Dad kneels, sitting back on his heels, and sets the record on the player; Calvin sits watching.
3: Dad kneels and gestures; Calvin sits looking up at him, the player between them.
drawing: Nothing of Dad is drawn in code. See tools/extensions/graft/README.md for the method and for what was tried before it.
